key_findings: Review of sirtuins (SIRT1-7) as neuroprotective targets in early brain injury after subarachnoid hemorrhage.
SIRT1 activation reduces NLRP3, HMGB1/NF-kB inflammation, oxidative stress and BBB disruption in SAH models.
